hero.title: ArcGIS Online
hero.subtitle: Mapping and spatial location intelligence for everyone

intro.text: Part of the Esri Geospatial Cloud, ArcGIS Online enables you to connect people, locations, and data using interactive maps. Work with smart, data-driven styles and intuitive analysis tools to gain location-based insights. Deliver location intelligence. Share your insights with the world or specific groups.

items.title: Make maps
items.desc: Quickly create maps of insights in your ArcGIS Online account using drag-and-drop workflows.

items.title: Share & collaborate
items.desc: Instantly share your maps with groups, partners, or the public. Work securely with your organization through roles and privileges.

items.title: Analyze data
items.desc: Intuitive analysis tools help you uncover patterns, perform site, network, and suitability analysis.

items.title: Work with your data
items.desc: Bring in data from spreadsheets, apps, and services. Enrich, style, and transform it.

tabs.label: Cloud-based
tabs.title: Cloud-based
tabs.desc: Because it’s hosted as a service, ArcGIS Online can be used anytime, anywhere. Your maps scale to millions of users without server upkeep.

tabs.label: Secure & private
tabs.title: Secure & private
tabs.desc: Enterprise-grade security and privacy controls built in.

tabs.label: Simple to deploy
tabs.title: Simple to deploy
tabs.desc: Get started quickly with ready-to-use content and apps.

cards.title: Developer tools
cards.desc: APIs and SDKs for building custom mapping and analysis apps.

cards.title: Field operations
cards.desc: Coordinate field work with mobile apps integrated with your maps.

cards.title: Advanced workflows
cards.desc: Do more with advanced analysis using ArcGIS Pro and extensions.

cards.title: Data & maps
cards.desc: Ready-to-use maps and authoritative data layers for your projects.
